content_raw: Now that The Boys is finally over, actor Antony Starr has taken to Instagram to bid farewell to his time as Homelander with a very spoiler-y photo gallery. Warning! Spoilers for The Boys series finale follow. "Ok I feel like spoilers aren’t really a thing now but…spoilers," Starr said in the caption of his post, which opens with a video of him ripping off the gory makeup he graced in The Boys Season 5 finale. "Last [behind the scenes] from the epic conclusion of the trauma created baby man wrapped monster suit that was Homie. Love to all the cast, crew and fans. It’s been a hell of a ride. ox." The full post, published just days after The Boys came to a bloody end earlier this week, is, indeed, packed with spoilers. In addition to what looks to be quite a cathartic video for the actor, it comes with 13 images of him palling around with co-stars like Jack Quaid (Hughie), Karl Urban (Butcher), and Karen Fukuhara (Kimiko) before filming wrapped. Those who tuned into The Boys series finale via Prime Video or at their local theater will immediately recognize Starr's makeup in the Instagram posts as the same, scarred look Homelander had when Butcher plunged a crowbar into his skull and popped it open. It was a gruesome moment that saw the once all-powerful supervillain without his powers as the rest of the supe-killing crew finally finished their mission, but behind the scenes, things were all peachy.
